{{Quote|Nym has put me in charge of pulling up some of the unintended foliage around the stronghold and city. All you need to do is find weeds, pull them up and dispose of them properly.|[[Ran Machado]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WWFR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Weed Whacker Foliage Requisition|Lok}}</ref>}}
A [[Species/Legends|species]] of '''flowering cactus''' was found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Nym/Legends|Nym]], the leader of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], ordered [[Ran Machado]] to oversee the removal of unintended foliage from [[Nym's Stronghold]]. The latter therefore recruited a spacer to pull up some flowering cacti and other kinds of [[Lokkian weed]]s in the city.<ref name="SWG:WWFR" /> After succeeding in the mission, the spacer used the extra weed to feed the [[kusak]]s guarding the city: [[Runt (kusak)|Runt]], [[Bedhead]], [[Blinky]], [[Scarecrow (kusak)|Scarecrow]], [[Slobbers]], [[Troubles]], [[Wart Face]], [[Gargle]], [[Ding (kusak)|Ding]] and [[Speedbump]].<ref name="SWG:CftK">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Caring for the Kusaks}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Flowering cacti appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Flowering cacti were originally present as random flora on the planet Lok upon the first release of the game.<ref name="SWG" /> The plant was later included in a quest of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:WWFR" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
